title: Private Culinary Walking Tour in Old Quebec Cultural
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
This private walking tour leads you through the cultural heart of Old Quebec. You wander ancient streets lined with colonial and classical architecture. Explore charming squares and experience centuries of civilization through local culinary traditions. Visit artisan markets and bakeries where recipes reflect the city’s classical and cultural legacy. Each aroma, taste, and sight tells a story of architectural and historical evolution. Marvel at UNESCO Heritage façades as you discover how Old Quebec’s culinary practices are rooted in its cultural depth. Conclude immersed in flavors and history that celebrate the city’s enduring legacy.

Please note: The program and attractions may vary based on booking date/time and crowd conditions, ensuring each visit is a unique experience.
